body.name: Sigmahat
body.def: \(\widehat\Sigma_F=J_F(\widehat p_N)\{\operatorname{diag}(\widehat p_N)-\widehat p_N\widehat p_N^{\mathsf T}\}J_F(\widehat p_N)^{\mathsf T}\) when \(\widehat p_N\in\mathcal U\), and \(\widehat\Sigma_F=0\) otherwise.
body.role: Total plug-in covariance estimator whose zero fallback is used only outside the local extension neighborhood.
